job.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. 


About the Katwijk Site

Eli Lilly is investing €2.6 billion in a new state-of-the-art manufacturing facility in Katwijk, Netherlands. This facility will produce oral medicines for cardiometabolic health, neuroscience, oncology, and immunology, incorporating next-generation manufacturing technologies including dock-to-dock automation, paperless manufacturing, and process analytical technology while achieving carbon neutrality and zero waste to landfills.

Position Overview

The Sr Director, Process, Maintenance & Automation Engineering provides strategic and operational leadership for Process Engineering, Automation, and Maintenance functions at the Katwijk site. This role ensures the reliability, compliance, and continuous performance of manufacturing equipment, control systems, and automated technologies. As a member of the Site Leadership Team, the incumbent will champion next-generation manufacturing capabilities — including paperless operations, dock-to-dock automation, and process analytical technology — while delivering a world-class, GMP-compliant maintenance programme from site startup through steady-state operations.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & People Management

  • Develop vision and operational discipline across Process Engineering, Automation, and Maintenance functions in accordance with Eli Lilly Manufacturing Standards.

  • Provide supervisory direction for department leaders, employees, and contractors across all supported functions.

  • Conduct performance appraisals, salary reviews, and HRP sessions; develop talent assessment, career, and succession plans.

  • Foster a culture of technical excellence, safety, and continuous improvement.

Process Engineering

  • Ensure regulatory compliance from an equipment, instrumentation, and process performance perspective.

  • Provide technical leadership for troubleshooting, deviation resolution, change management, safety assessments, and lifecycle management of manufacturing processes.

  • Drive initiatives that improve process efficiency, compliance, and productivity.

  • Coordinate engineering support for manufacturing operations and daily activities.

Automation & Technology

  • Implement and manage automated systems and technologies, including dock-to-dock automation, paperless manufacturing, and process analytical technology (PAT).

  • Ensure compliance with Computer Systems Validation (CSV), Infrastructure Platform Qualification, and Software Quality practices.

  • Ensure compliance with FDA regulations including 21 CFR Part 11 and applicable computer systems regulations.

  • Oversee the lifecycle management of automation platforms, control systems, and digital manufacturing tools.

Maintenance Programme

  • Oversee the development, implementation, and execution of a comprehensive maintenance programme encompassing preventive, corrective, and predictive maintenance, as well as planning and scheduling.

  • Oversee technical maintenance services including pressure vessels, spare parts, CMMS, mechanical integrity, calibration, and reliability services.

  • Ensure adequate lifecycle management of plant assets and equipment.

  • Coordinate and allocate resources for daily maintenance operations and projects.

Financial Management

  • Develop and manage annual expense and capital budgets for Process Engineering, Automation, and Maintenance departments.

  • Control expenses and capital expenditures; ensure monthly and annual financial reporting and forecasting is timely and accurate.

  • Supervise monthly reporting of departmental performance metrics.

Quality, Compliance & EHS

  • Ensure all operations comply with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), Good Documentation Practices, and applicable regulatory requirements.

  • Ensure compliance with EHS regulatory agencies and Eli Lilly EHS Corporate Policies; integrate EHS requirements into business planning.

  • Model desired safety culture through actions and decisions; conduct regular management audits of areas.

  • Establish and monitor metrics for inspections, training, and incidents.

  • Ensure thorough, accurate, and up-to-date training for all employees and contractors.

Qualifications & Requirements

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Chemical, Electrical, Mechanical, or equivalent).

  • Ideally bilingual — English and Dutch preferred.

Experience

  • 10+ years of experience in engineering-related fields.

  • 7+ years in manufacturing, preferably in pharmaceutical or other regulated industries.

  • Demonstrated experience in process engineering, automation systems, and maintenance management in a GMP-regulated environment.

Technical Knowledge

  • Knowledge of pharmaceutical regulations including cGMPs, 21 CFR Part 11, and FDA Computer Systems regulations.

  • Knowledge of Computer Systems Validation (CSV), Infrastructure Platform Qualification, and Software Quality practices.

  • Knowledge of System Lifecycle management, software engineering, design principles, and infrastructure operations.

  • Knowledge of process safety management principles.

  • Familiarity with CMMS platforms and reliability-centred maintenance methodologies.

Leadership & Interpersonal Skills

  • Effective leadership, teamwork, interpersonal, and communication skills.

  • Excellent technical writing, negotiation, and presentation capabilities.

  • Ability to work with minimal supervision, manage competing priorities, and drive results in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

  • Strong decision-making, problem-solving, and organisational skills.

  • Ability to influence and develop others; self-starter with strong self-management skills.

  • Knowledge of applicable local, national, and EU transportation, shipping, and waste disposal regulations — including Dutch authorities such as ILT (Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport), ADR/RID standards for dangerous goods transport, RIVM environmental guidelines, and any municipal or provincial permitting requirements — as well as familiarity with customs and cross-border logistics regulations within the European Union.

  • Build, develop, and lead the supply chain and MMC team; administer performance plans, set challenging goals, and drive succession planning.
  • Ensure team members have individualised training plans and development opportunities aligned with their roles.

Cross-Functional & Corporate Engagement

  • Represent the Katwijk site to global supply chain functions, Lilly partner sites, affiliates, and contract manufacturing organisations.
  • Actively participate in the site annual business and strategic planning process.
  • Communicate strategy and plans to Lilly global manufacturing leadership.
  • Support Lilly security assessments for warehousing operations.

Basic Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Science, Supply Chain Management, or Business Administration.
  • Minimum 7 years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry or equivalent, with significant experience in warehousing, planning, and logistics operations.
  • 5+ years of supply chain experience and 3+ years of logistics operational experience.
  • Knowledge of international shipping regulations, including safety, security, and EU import/export compliance.
  • In-depth understanding of logistics and planning tools with the ability to integrate manufacturing, logistics, and planning at a systems level.
  • Fluent in English (written and spoken). Dutch language proficiency is a strong advantage.

Additional Preferences

  • Understanding of supply and demand principles and drivers, including product-cycle-specific dynamics.
  • Experience in business planning, preparing and executing business plans, and accountability for financial results.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to generate, evaluate, and articulate complex supply chain solutions.
  • Analytical thinking with the ability to work effectively across multiple organisational levels.
  • Knowledge of GMP, EU GDP, and EHS regulations in a pharmaceutical manufacturing setting.
  • Experience building supply chain operations for a greenfield manufacturing site.
